items.title: Requests to approved AI destinations are decrypted and scanned
items.detail: A destination allowlist decides where data may go. It is not a substitute for looking at what is sent.

applicability.reason: No architecture facts are declared yet for this course, so nothing can rule the item out. The fact model is an open owner decision.

items.title: The scanner reads content the way the destination will
items.detail: JSON escapes and declared base64 attachments are decoded before any detector runs. A body that does not decode is blocked.

applicability.reason: No architecture facts are declared yet for this course, so nothing can rule the item out. The fact model is an open owner decision.

items.title: A body over the scan limit is blocked for AI destinations
items.detail: It is never passed unscanned. The limit is recorded and tested with a body one byte over it.

items.title: Every AI host on the bypass list has an owner, a reason, a review date and a compensating control
